title: Flow-Corrected Shape Optimization: Taming Manifold Drift in High-Dimensional 3D Models
figure: First optimizer-corrector framework that mitigates manifold drift in high-dimensional 3D shape models via flow matching.
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of manifold drift in optimizing 3D shapes within deep generative models. It presents a novel optimizer-corrector framework that alternates between objective minimization and guided flow matching, ensuring geometric validity while maintaining expressiveness. The method is shown to be effective across various generative priors and optimization tasks.

title: Floating Radiance Networks
figure: First neural scene representation combining explicit geometry with continuous radiance functions via floating planar primitives
abstract: Floating Radiance Networks (FlaRe) introduces a neural scene representation that integrates explicit ray-traceable geometry with continuous neural radiance functions. It utilizes floating planar generalized Gaussian primitives for efficient rendering and manipulation, supporting high-fidelity neural rendering and geometric editing. The method demonstrates competitive quality in standard benchmarks

title: To See a World in a Living Context: Unified Indoor-Outdoor Urban World Generation
figure: First framework to unify indoor and outdoor generation within a coherent 3D urban world via autoregressive modeling
abstract: HoloWorld is a framework for unified indoor-outdoor urban world generation, allowing for coherent spatial organization and visual identity across blocks. It generates urban exteriors and corresponding interiors based on user descriptions, maintaining building-specific characteristics. The method shows significant performance improvements over existing approaches.

title: Hierarchical Flow Matching for 3D Point Cloud Generation
figure: First hierarchical flow matching method for unconditional 3D point cloud generation.
abstract: The paper introduces Hierarchical Flow Matching (HFM), a method for generating high-quality 3D point clouds by capturing both global shape topology and local geometric details. HFM employs a bilevel structure for efficient sampling and supports downstream tasks, achieving competitive performance on ShapeNet and ModelNet benchmarks.

title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing
figure: First unified multimodal model for scalable 3D generation, understanding, and editing via a single architecture
abstract: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0 is a unified framework that integrates 3D understanding, text-to-3D generation, and instruction-guided editing. It utilizes a large-scale multimodal corpus for training and combines different models for high-fidelity 3D synthesis. The framework shows state-of-the-art performance in 3D generation and editing tasks, highlighting the benefits of unified training.

title: Learning to Tessellate: Point Cloud Generation via Recursive Spectral Partitioning
figure: First autoregressive point cloud generator that preserves topology via recursive spectral partitioning.
abstract: PointRSP introduces an autoregressive framework for point cloud generation that maintains topological coherence through a topology-aware partitioning autoencoder. It reformulates generation as a tessellation process, utilizing a dual-stream cascaded generator for structural evolution and feature synthesis. The method achieves state-of-the-art performance in quality and diversity across complex 3D

title: Beyond Global Latents: Chunk-Based Sparse Grid VAE for Scalable 3D Modeling
figure: First sparse grid VAE that organizes around local chunks for scalable 3D modeling.
abstract: ChunkVAE introduces a sparse grid variational autoencoder that focuses on local chunks instead of a global latent volume, allowing for flexible encoder and decoder partitions. This method improves memory efficiency and computation speed while maintaining reconstruction quality across various object benchmarks.

title: PartMat: Material-Aware 3D Part Decomposition with a Single Global Latent
figure: First material-aware 3D part decomposition that uses a single global latent via VAE and diffusion.
abstract: PartMat introduces a material-aware 3D part decomposition method that efficiently generates structured 3D assets by focusing on material boundaries. It utilizes a unified representation to decode parts in a single pass and employs a diffusion model for part generation, achieving high accuracy and fine geometric details while reducing computational costs.
